A naval commander based on Nomijima, in the service of the Kobayakawa clan.
He alerts the Mouri Army to the Amago invasion of Bingo and asks for reinforcements. (Ep. 8)
Kobayakawa Takakage, who was to be adopted into a branch family of the Kobayakawa, inherits the main house instead. As a result, Munekatsu operates alongside the Mouri Army from then on. (Ep. 9)
In the Battle of Itsukushima, he wins Murakami Takeyoshi over to the Mouri side through Kurushima Michiyasu. (Ep. 12)

An Oda retainer and a nephew of Hashiba Hideyoshi, who raises him as if he were his own son.

An Oda retainer. A commander raised from boyhood by Hashiba Hideyoshi, he is known for his tremendous strength.
In the Pursuit of the Hashiba Army, he appears as if to strike at the Mouri Army from behind. (Ep. 24)

A Mouri retainer and the son of Fukubara Hirotoshi. Like his father, he leads the spearmen.
Succeeding his father, who died while the Mouri Army was away relieving Kanayama Castle, he takes part in the Battle of Kanayama Castle.
(Ep. 4)

A Mouri retainer and the son of Fukubara Hirotoshi. Like his father, he leads the spearmen.
Succeeding his father, who died while the Mouri Army was away relieving Kanayama Castle, he takes part in the Battle of Kanayama Castle.
(Ep. 4)
From then on, like his father, he serves as the foremost of the Mouri clan's senior retainers.
As the Mouri Army moves to conquer the Ouchi lands, he handles the diplomacy meant to avoid strife with the Otomo clan. (Ep. 13)

(Ep. 4)

A Mouri retainer. Within the clan, he and Shiji Hiroyoshi are what one might call its senior retainers.

(Ep. 15)
Wife of Mouri Okimoto and mother of Komatsumaru.

Wife of Mouri Okimoto and mother of Komatsumaru.
She loses Okimoto, who dies young, his health ruined by drink. (Ep. 1)

Wife of Mouri Okimoto and mother of Komatsumaru.
She loses Okimoto, who dies young, his health ruined by drink. (Ep. 1)
After her husband, she loses her son Komatsumaru too, and returns to her home province. (Ep. 3)

A bandit. After quarreling with his father, he ran away from home and joined a gang of bandits. He once came close to attacking Mouri Motonari's party on its way back from the Kikkawa castle. But later, his father's death leads him to mend his ways, and he joins the Mouri Army. (Ep. 4)

A noble thief. After quarreling with his father, he ran away from home and joined a gang of bandits. He once came close to attacking Mouri Motonari's party on its way back from the Kikkawa castle. But later, his father's death leads him to mend his ways, and he joins the Mouri Army. (Ep. 4)

An Oda retainer. He first serves Ashikaga Yoshiaki, but approaches Oda Nobunaga to arrange Yoshiaki's march on Kyoto, and later enters the service of the Oda clan. He is also one of the most cultured men of the Sengoku era.
In the Kinai Offensive, he appears as reinforcements for the Akechi side and faces the Mouri Army. (Ep. 25)
Daughter of Seki Masakiyo. She joins the Mouri Army as a kunoichi.

Daughter of Seki Masakiyo, though not by birth: when the Ouchi clan met its end at Nagato-Katsuyama Castle, Seki took her in and raised her. As a kunoichi she aids her father, and she also becomes a source of strength for Terumoto.
Eldest son of Honganji Kennyo. Together with his father, he resists Oda Nobunaga at Ishiyama Hongan-ji.

The eleventh head abbot of Hongan-ji. Declaring Oda Nobunaga an enemy of the Buddha, he fights on to the bitter end at Ishiyama Hongan-ji.
But when the Oda Army surrounds Ishiyama Hongan-ji, he asks the Mouri Army for help. (Ep. 22)
A local lord of Iwami, allied with the Amago. Bracing for the Mouri Army's attack on Iwami Ginzan, he takes charge of the silver mine's defense. (Ep. 15)

A local lord of Iwami, allied with the Amago. Bracing for the Mouri Army's attack on Iwami Ginzan, he takes charge of the silver mine's defense. (Ep. 15)
In the Battle of Iwami Ginzan, when the Mouri Army draws near, he orders the mine entrances destroyed and the silver carried off. (Ep. 15)
A Tokugawa retainer. A fierce warrior who, for all the battles he has fought, has never suffered so much as a scratch.

A pirate and the leader of a naval band based in Bungo. In the Struggle for Moji Castle, Kenichiro faces the Mouri Army at the Otomo Army's request, but is persuaded by Nomi Munekatsu to join the Mouri Army. (Ep. 14)

A pirate chief and the leader of a naval band based in Bungo. In the Struggle for Moji Castle, Kenichiro faces the Mouri Army at the Otomo Army's request, but is persuaded by Nomi Munekatsu to join the Mouri Army. (Ep. 14)
An Oda retainer. Known as "Mataza of the Spear," he boasts many feats of arms.

An Oda retainer. Known as "Mataza of the Spear," he boasts many feats of arms.
In the Pacification of Mino and Owari, he appears with Shibata Katsuie and tries to strike the Mouri Army's main camp. (Ep. 26)

A local lord of Iwami, originally on the Ouchi side. After Sue Harukata's rebellion, he follows Harukata and turns against the Mouri clan.
In the Battle of Iwami Ginzan, he joins the fight as reinforcements at the Amago's request. Persuaded by Kikkawa Motoharu, he serves with the Mouri Army from then on. (Ep. 15)

en:
An Amago retainer. He holds Shiraga Castle, a satellite castle of Gassan-Toda Castle.
In the Siege of Shiraga Castle, he defends Shiraga Castle against the Mouri Army but is no match for them, and the castle falls. (Ep. 16)

An Ouchi retainer. Within the clan, he belongs to the military faction and rallies to Sue Harukata's rebellion.

When the Amago Army invades Bingo, he holds his castle while asking the Mouri for reinforcements, and from then on serves with the Mouri Army. (Ep. 8)

A local lord of Bingo, based at Hiebiyama Castle. On the Ouchi side, he takes part in the Ouchi attack on Gassan-Toda Castle.
When the Amago Army invades Bingo, he holds his castle while asking the Mouri for reinforcements. (Ep. 8)

A local lord of Bitchu, based at Matsuyama Castle.
His father is killed when Ukita Naoie of Bizen invades. Then Bitchu, too, is taken from him, and he turns to the Mouri clan for help. (Ep. 19)

A local lord of Bitchu, based at Matsuyama Castle.
His father is killed when Ukita Naoie of Bizen invades. Then Bitchu, too, is taken from him, and he turns to the Mouri clan for help. (Ep. 19)
But in the Bizen Campaign, his sworn enemy Ukita Naoie surrenders to the Mouri. Motochika defects to the Oda side, which has long been courting him, and tries to destroy the Mouri Army, but is defeated and beheaded. (Ep. 21)
An Ouchi retainer, one of the military faction within the clan.
